claims.statement: Pinned roadmap guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES and visualizes issues/PRs/drafts on timeline using custom date/iteration fields; source reusable states dragging changes dates or selected iteration. Timeline is not passive-only display or deadline enforcement.

Switching to roadmap attempts reuse of existing date/iteration fields; automatic selection is not verified intended start/target mapping. Resolve exact field IDs and units before any authorized scheduling change.

Date-fields menu can create new date/iteration field and choose Start date/Target date. Source does not specify absent values, reversed ranges, shared field identity, timezone or mixed date/iteration behavior; no validation guarantee inferred.

Vertical markers show selected iterations, item dates and associated milestones. Presence/absence of marker is display configuration, not authoritative schedule completeness or proof underlying milestone state.
Zoom Month/Quarter/Year changes density and visible horizon, not item retention or applicability. Off-screen or filtered item must remain in assessment denominator unless explicit scoped exclusion.

Slice works with current filter; sort/group use shared field procedures, with title/labels/reviewers/linked PR group exclusions. Filtering/grouping is not permission control or verification of all items.
Number sums appear in grouped roadmap headers; they are field-value aggregation, not measured effort, valid acceptance score or complete unfiltered workload evidence.

Complete guide and previously read roadmap/slice/sort/group/sum/menu fragments reviewed. No fields created, roadmap configured or items dragged; all claims reference-only, no rights clearance, accepted policy or native behavior.
